skills.level1_stats: MP -25; Attack without using up any arrows for 60 sec
skills.max_level_stats: MP -5; Attack without using up any arrows for 300 sec

skills.name: Iron Arrow: Crossbow
skills.description: [Master Level: 30] Attacks up to 4 monsters at once with a powerful arrow, which penetrates through them. Damage decreases as the arrow flies through each monster.
skills.level1_stats: MP -14; Damage 130%
skills.max_level_stats: MP -28; Damage 190%

skills.name: Nimble Body
skills.description: [Master Level : 15] Increases Accuracy and Avoidability.
skills.level1_stats: Accuracy +1, Avoidability +1
skills.max_level_stats: Accuracy +15, Avoidability +15

skills.name: Keen Eyes
skills.description: [Master Level: 15] Increases attack range for throwing weapons such as throwing stars & knives. Required Skill: At least Level 3 on Nimble Body
skills.level1_stats: Attack range for throwing weapons: +10
skills.max_level_stats: Attack range for throwing weapons: +150

skills.name: Disorder
skills.description: [Master Level: 20] Temporarily decreases the Attack Power and Weapon Def. of an enemy and dissuades it from attacking you. Has no effect on a monster that's already in "Disorder."
skills.level1_stats: MP -5; Enemy's Attack Power -5, Weapon Def. -5% for 10 sec
skills.max_level_stats: MP -10; Enemy's Attack Power -25, Weapon Def. -10% for 30 sec

skills.name: Dark Sight
skills.description: [Master Level : 20] Use MP to hide behind the shadows. Can't be attacked, and can't attack either. The effect is activated when used and deactivated when used again. Required Skill : At least Level 3 on Disorder
skills.level1_stats: MP -50; Disappear into the shadows, Speed -20 while active
skills.max_level_stats: MP -30; Disappear into the shadows, regular movement speed while active

skills.name: Double Stab
skills.description: [Master Level: 20] Use MP to quickly stab a monster twice in one turn using a dagger.
skills.level1_stats: MP -8; Damage 80%
skills.max_level_stats: MP -16; Damage 160%

skills.name: Lucky Seven
skills.description: [Master Level : 20] Use MP to throw 2 throwing stars and apply damage based on LUK, regardless of the rate of Claw Mastery.
skills.level1_stats: MP -8; Damage 60%
skills.max_level_stats: MP -16; Damage 120%

skills.name: Claw Mastery
skills.description: [Master Level: 20] Increases Claw Mastery and Attack Power, and gives a chance to recover used throwing stars when using throwing star attacks. Only applies when a claw is equipped.
skills.level1_stats: Claw Mastery level 1, Attack Power +1, 5% chance to retrieve used throwing stars
skills.max_level_stats: Claw Mastery level 10, Attack Power +20, 25% chance to retrieve used throwing stars

skills.name: Critical Throw

skills.max_level_stats: Critical Rate +15%, Critical Damage +35%

skills.name: Critical Recovery
skills.description: [Master Level: 20] Recovers additional HP and MP with a certain chance when landing a critical hit. Cannot recover again within 30 seconds after a recovery.
skills.level1_stats: Recover 1% HP and 1% MP with a 20% chance when landing a critical hit

skills.max_level_stats: HP -10, MP -10; Increases Claw Attack Speed by 2 stages for 300 sec
